activity_summary: The week's share came to thirty shillings, the best since Christmas, in a yard the snow had thinned. Margery was right to the penny. Garnish read the margin: Kemp's interest, Thursday, eleven lines, and no song. Kemp asked the interest on Burbage and was told there is no such column. You said thirty shillings, and nothing clever. Edith's eight shillings stayed under the candlestick, unpaid. The watchet stayed unpaid. Heminges asked, half in jest, for a Love's Labour's Won. You said you have not written it, and will not.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said thirty shillings, refused the jest, and added nothing clever.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named the share, kept the unpaid papers out of the division, and asked half in jest for a play that does not exist.

entities.name: Goodwife Margery Pell
entities.context: Stood over her box and was right to the penny.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Read eleven lines from the margin, and gave Burbage no twin column.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Asked the interest on Burbage, owned the eleven, and added nothing this afternoon.

entities.name: Edith Kettlewood
entities.context: Is not in the room. Her eight shillings stay under the candlestick, unpaid.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in Thirty shillings, and eleven lines

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: I ask it half in jest.
